headline: 104°F Saturday — tip canes now, onions at maturity.
weather_notes: Work before 9 AM through Sunday — Extreme Heat Warning active through Aug 2 at 9 PM with 101°F today and 104°F Saturday.
Run both zones early Saturday morning — irrigation will be 2 days out at 104°F, past the 1-day heat threshold.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM through Sunday — 41-day transplants at sustained 101–104°F risk sunscald and blossom drop.
Hand-check potato bags for moisture each morning — containers dry 2–3× faster than raised beds at 104°F.
